name: inject
ev: (async()=>{ await ensureKnownDevs('PS011871'); const cp = await apiCall('/api/zuken/circuit-path?ps=PS011871&q=394'); ZUKEN_STATE.lastCircuit = cp; circuitShowCoil('K1'); return !!document.getElementById('circuit-overlay'); })()

(()=>{const sc=document.querySelector('#circuit-overlay .cov-scroll'); const g=[...sc.querySelectorAll('svg text')].find(x=>/S300/.test(x.textContent)); sc.scrollTop += g.getBoundingClientRect().top - sc.getBoundingClientRect().top - 150; return 1})()
